Professional work

Low-poly game assets

Worked collaboratively with a team of 10 game designers to develop low-poly assets for a multi-year, university-funded, student-led educational game project.

  • Created, developed, and implemented 3D assets for a playable game board, including building and environmental assets, as well as walkable and interactive game tiles.
  • Worked collaboratively with the development team to support the visual design and functionality of game environments.
